title: Hand Towel Bar Wall Mount 6.65-Inch Solid Brass Essex Collection | Classic Bath Accessory Towel Holder | Allied Brass
description:
Add a refined, traditional accent at the sink with this wall mount hand towel bar from the Essex collection. Crafted from solid brass, it keeps a hand towel or washcloth within easy reach while helping save floor space.

Highlights:
- Part of the coordinated Essex collection for matching essex pieces
- Classic, heritage-inspired design for traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories
- Solid brass construction
- Multiple designer finish options available
- Mounting hardware included; no assembly required

Specs:
- Type: Towel bar / hand towel holder
- Dimensions: 6.65 in L x 2.1 in H x 3.39 in projection
- Bar diameter: 0.5 in
- Weight capacity: 5 lb
- Made in the USA
- Limited Lifetime Warranty
